**Prepared by:** [Owner Name] · **Date:** [Date] · **Contact:** [Email / Phone]

[A one-page overview: what the business does, the problem it solves, the target market, and what you're asking for (funding, partnership, or internal buy-in). Write this section last.]

[Legal structure (e.g. LLC, corporation), location, founding story, and mission.]

## 3. Products and Services
[What you sell, how it works, and what makes it different from alternatives.]

## 4. Market Analysis
[Industry size and growth trends, target customer segments, and key competitors — cite sources where possible: [Source Name/Link].]

## 5. Marketing and Sales Strategy
[How customers will find you (channels), your pricing approach, and how sales are closed and retained.]

## 6. Operations Plan
[Day-to-day workflow, key suppliers or vendors, facilities/equipment needed, and staffing plan.]

[Founders/key leaders and relevant experience. Note any advisors or board members.]

## 8. Financial Plan
[Startup costs, revenue projections for [Year 1 / Year 2 / Year 3], break-even analysis, and funding requested (if any) with intended use of funds.]

## 9. Milestones and Timeline
- [Milestone 1 — target date]
- [Milestone 2 — target date]
- [Milestone 3 — target date]

## 10. Appendix
[Supporting documents: resumes, letters of intent, permits, detailed financial spreadsheets, etc.]

*This document is provided for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute legal, tax, or investment advice. Have an accountant review your financial projections before presenting this plan to lenders or investors.*

[The underlying purpose or impact — the change the organization is trying to make.]

bodyMarkdown:
# Stock Purchase Agreement

This Agreement is made on [Date] between [Seller Name] ("Seller") and [Buyer Name] ("Buyer") regarding shares of [Company Name], a [State] corporation (the "Company").

## 1. Purchase and Sale
Seller agrees to sell, and Buyer agrees to purchase, [Number of Shares] shares of [Class of Stock, e.g. common stock] of the Company (the "Shares") for a total purchase price of [Purchase Price] (the "Purchase Price").

## 2. Payment
Buyer will pay the Purchase Price by [Payment Method] on or before the Closing Date.

## 3. Closing
The sale will close on [Closing Date] (the "Closing"), at which time Seller will deliver the Shares, duly endorsed for transfer, and Buyer will deliver the Purchase Price.

## 4. Seller's Representations
Seller represents that: (a) Seller has good and marketable title to the Shares, free of liens or encumbrances; (b) Seller has full authority to sell the Shares; and (c) to Seller's knowledge, the Company is not in material breach of any agreement that would affect the value of the Shares.

## 5. Buyer's Representations
Buyer represents that Buyer has the funds and authority necessary to complete the purchase and, [where applicable,] is acquiring the Shares for investment purposes and not with a view to unregistered resale.

## 6. Conditions to Closing
Closing is conditioned on: [e.g. Company board or shareholder approval of the transfer, any required third-party consents, accuracy of representations as of the Closing Date].

## 7. Restrictions on Transfer
The Shares [are/are not] subject to a right of first refusal or other transfer restrictions under the Company's governing documents. [Buyer acknowledges reviewing the Company's bylaws/shareholder agreement before signing.]

## 8. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of [State].

---
Seller: ______________________  Date: ____________
Buyer: ______________________  Date: ____________

*This document is provided for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute legal or tax advice. Private stock transfers can trigger securities law requirements and may need company or shareholder consent — consult a licensed attorney before relying on this template.*

bodyMarkdown:
# Stock Option Agreement

This Agreement is made on [Date] between [Company Name], a [State] corporation (the "Company"), and [Optionee Name] (the "Optionee"), under the Company's [Stock Option Plan Name] (the "Plan").

## 1. Grant of Option
The Company grants the Optionee an option to purchase [Number of Shares] shares of the Company's [Class of Stock] (the "Option") at an exercise price of [Exercise Price] per share (the "Exercise Price"), subject to the terms of this Agreement and the Plan.

## 2. Vesting Schedule
The Option vests as follows: [e.g. 25% on the first anniversary of the Vesting Commencement Date of [Date], with the remainder vesting monthly over the following 36 months], subject to the Optionee's continued service through each vesting date.

## 3. Exercise Period
The Option may be exercised, to the extent vested, until the earlier of [Expiration Date, e.g. 10 years from the grant date] or [Period, e.g. 90 days] after the Optionee's termination of service, except as otherwise provided in the Plan.

## 4. Method of Exercise
The Optionee may exercise the Option by delivering written notice to the Company along with payment of the Exercise Price by [Payment Method — e.g. cash, check, or net exercise, if permitted under the Plan].

## 5. Type of Option
This Option is intended to qualify as [an Incentive Stock Option ("ISO") under Section 422 of the Internal Revenue Code / a Non-Qualified Stock Option ("NSO")], subject to applicable tax rules and limits.

## 6. Transferability
The Option is not transferable other than by will or the laws of descent and distribution, and may be exercised during the Optionee's lifetime only by the Optionee.

## 7. Effect of the Plan
This Agreement is subject to all terms of the Plan, which is incorporated by reference. In the event of a conflict, the Plan controls.

---

Optionee: ______________________  Date: ____________

# Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) — [Company Name]

## 1. Purpose
This plan lets eligible employees purchase [Company Name] stock at a discount through regular payroll deductions.

## 2. Eligibility
Employees who have completed [Service requirement] and work at least [Hours/week] are eligible to enroll.

## 3. Offering Periods
Stock is offered in [Length, e.g. "6-month"] offering periods beginning [Dates, e.g. "January 1 and July 1"].

## 4. Payroll Contributions
Employees may contribute between [Minimum]% and [Maximum]% of eligible compensation per pay period, up to [dollar/annual limit].

## 5. Purchase Price
Shares are purchased at [Discount]% of the fair market value on [the first day of the offering period / the last day / whichever is lower — a "look-back" provision].

## 6. Purchase Date
Accumulated contributions are used to purchase shares on the last trading day of each offering period.

## 7. Withdrawal
Employees may withdraw from the current offering period by submitting a withdrawal form before [Deadline]; contributions to date are refunded.

## 8. Administration
This plan is administered by [Role/Committee], which may amend or terminate the plan prospectively.

---
Adopted by the Board on [Date].

*This differs from a stock option plan: ESPP participants buy actual shares now, at a discount, rather than receiving the right to buy later at a fixed price. In the US, staying within IRS Section 423 rules (offering limits, look-back structure) is what keeps this a "qualified" plan with more favorable tax treatment.*

seoTitle: Free Restricted Stock Award Agreement Template
description: Free restricted stock award (RSA) agreement template for granting actual shares subject to vesting, distinct from an RSU grant.
bodyMarkdown:
# Restricted Stock Award Agreement

**Company:** [Company Name] · **Recipient:** [Recipient Name] · **Grant Date:** [Date]

## 1. Grant
Subject to this Agreement and the Company's [Equity Incentive Plan Name], the Company grants Recipient [Number] shares of [Class] common stock (the "Shares"), issued as of the Grant Date and subject to the vesting and repurchase terms below.

## 2. Vesting Schedule
The Shares vest as follows: [e.g. "25% after one year, then monthly over the following 36 months"]. Unvested Shares remain subject to the Company's repurchase right in Section 3.

## 3. Repurchase Right
If Recipient's service ends for any reason before the Shares are fully vested, the Company may repurchase any unvested Shares at [original purchase price / $0.00], at its option.

## 4. Section 83(b) Election
Because the Shares are issued at grant subject to vesting, Recipient may file a Section 83(b) election with the IRS within 30 days of the Grant Date to be taxed on their value now rather than as they vest. Recipient is solely responsible for this election and should consult a tax advisor.

## 5. Restrictions and Rights
Recipient may not sell, transfer, or pledge unvested Shares. Recipient holds voting and dividend rights in the Shares from the Grant Date, whether or not vested, unless the Plan states otherwise.

---
Company: ______________________  Date: ____________
Recipient: ______________________  Date: ____________

*This document is provided for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute legal or tax advice. An RSA differs from a Restricted Stock Unit (RSU): an RSA issues real shares at grant (enabling an 83(b) election), while an RSU only delivers shares later, at vesting. Consult a securities attorney and tax advisor before granting equity.*
